claim_scope: PROFILING_BASELINE_CAPTURE_FOR_INDEPENDENT_BOTTLENECK_ANALYSES; no policy change, no optimization, no diagnosis inside this capture
export: after the gates, export_v1 writes <output_root>/export_v1 (create-only CSV tables + MANIFEST.json with source and export SHA-256); each analysis starts with `export_v1 --verify-only`

gates.G1_FRAME_ACCOUNTING: exactly 1,000 frames at TRANSMITTED_BUDGET_REACHED, or exactly 999 at a verified DECISION_CYCLE_BOUNDARY (budget 1,000, no decision cap, boundary reached); matching transmission counts, one terminal per sent frame, zero unresolved tickets (the addendum-2 rule at budget 1,000)
gates.G2_ACTOR_HASH_UNCHANGED: weights SHA-256 equals the registered value before and after; the live actor's boundary equals the binding; the read-only actor audit passes before and after and is identical
gates.G3_ZERO_IDENTITY_CONFLICTS: no profiler record (UE, edge, map) disagrees with the transmitted identity of its frame; no edge/map record names an untransmitted frame; the Phase-6 integration identity checks pass
gates.G4_COVERAGE_REPORTED: per-stage coverage, denominators and missing counts are reported for every registered stage
gates.G5_SAMPLER_REPORTED: sampler header and footer present; interval P50/P95/max, dropped samples and sampler CPU reported
gates.G6_NO_PROFILER_INDUCED_FAULT: child exit 0; Phase-6 P8 (no infrastructure fault); zero edge processing failures; zero profiler write failures, dropped records and internal errors in every process
gates.G7_INSTRUMENTATION_EVIDENCE_VALID: every profiler stream has one header and one footer; no duplicate sequence, negative interval, crossed sibling, nesting-registry violation, out-of-parent span or non-monotonic per-thread timestamp; every CUDA span resolved or explicitly marked unresolved
gates.G8_REWARD_TIMEOUT_SEMANTICS: every live actor decision replays offline to the identical mode, q_e4, state and head digests; every resolution obeys the inclusive 170-ms deadline and the registered reward formula exactly; every feedback-receipt mark equals the authoritative receipt stamp; Phase-6 P3/P4/P5 pass
gates.G9_HOST_RESTORED_CLEAN: Phase-6 cleanup gates pass (tracer, application, CARLA, radio, cold-after); sampler exited with a footer; no profiler, edge, map or child process remains

lifecycle.rationale: the collector safety timeout is a wall-clock bound on the route loop (live_cell_child, time.monotonic) and also the route's maximum loop sim-seconds; the qualified 300-frame route took ~67 s wall, so 1,000 frames need ~220 s and would stop near frame 540 at the qualification's 120 s. 600 s / 1800 s are bounds only; the 170-ms reward clock, the 2-s edge GT wait and every other timeout are unchanged.
